name: comp-56
blurb: Tag input field with a list of tags below.
description: A tag input built with emblor library, with input field at the top and tags displayed in a list below. Includes close buttons for each tag. Starts with Sport, Coding, Travel.
use_when: Forms collecting multiple keywords, skills, or interests (tags, labels, categories).
avoid_when: You need tags displayed inline alongside the input or a different tag style.
a11y: Label linked to input. Tags are accessible with close buttons. Active tag state managed.
